declaration.preface:
Looking at the current scenario of persistent environmental degradation and the critical depletion of essential resources, Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. a textile based company conscientiously recognizes the pressing demand for proactive and responsible sustainable initiatives. We are steadfastly committed to seamlessly integrating Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into the heart of our daily operations. We have attained a significant presence in the global market by delivering high quality products and have positioned ourselves as a reliable and customer-focused manufacturer as well as supplier.

At Exim Knits Pvt Ltd., our resolute commitment to tackling sustainability challenges is embodied in our thorough Integrated Environment Policy. This highlights our proactive dedication to addressing a spectrum of environmental issues, such as energy consumption, water conservation, reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, preservation of biodiversity, adoption of renewable energy, air pollution control, and responsible management of hazardous waste. In response to these challenges, we have implemented innovative strategies in alignment with the core sustainability principles of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle.

We pledge to achieve excellence in environmental performance by continuous growth, evolution and maintenance of strong commitment to high standards in quality, innovation, and sustainability.
declaration.declaration: Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. is committed to fostering continual growth by seamlessly integrating financial growth along with environmental protection. Our aim is to implement innovative strategies that not only improve operational efficiency but also actively contribute to constructing a more resilient and sustainable future for generations to come.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

Energy Consumption and Greenhouse Gases: Embracing Sustainable Raw Materials: Advancing our textile industry practices through the incorporation of eco-friendly alternatives, encompassing organic cotton, recycled polyester, and other environmentally sustainable fabrics.

Environmentally Conscious Manufacturing process: Utilizing water-based or low-impact dyes and Integrating energy-efficient technologies to minimize emissions and adopt sustainable alternatives for eco-friendly manufacturing process.

Optimize transportation logistics: Integration of electric or hybrid vehicles, consolidating shipments, and exploring sustainable transport options to reduce reliance on fossil fuels and minimize emissions.

Implementation of Waste Management Strategies: Include recycling and upcycling programs, to minimize textile waste sent to landfills. Explore sustainable disposal methods such as methane capture from landfills and adopt eco-friendly incineration practices to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Water: Eco-Friendly Fabric Preference: Prioritizing fabrics with lower water usage in cultivation and processing, favoring sustainable alternatives

Implement water recycling and Optimized washing Techniques : Implement closed-loop water recycling systems to reuse water in dyeing and finishing processes. Develop and adopt technologies that optimize washing and rinsing processes, ensuring effective cleaning with reduced water requirements.

Optimize steam generation: Implementing efficient boiler systems, and recycling or treating water used in steam generation. This reduces water consumption and contributes to sustainable practices in the textile industry.
Air Pollution: Implement Green Technologies: Upgrade machinery and processes by adopting eco-friendly dyeing and finishing with water-based or low-impact dyes, reducing the release of harmful chemicals into the air.

Pollutants Emission Reduction: Implement air filtration systems and emission control devices in manufacturing units, capturing pollutants. Also, adopt dust suppression measures with proper ventilation and collection technologies during spinning and weaving processes.
Continuous Emission Monitoring: Continuously monitor and evaluate air quality in and around manufacturing facilities, facilitating swift identification and mitigation of potential pollution sources.
Materials, Chemicals, and Waste: Sustainable Raw Materials: Emphasize the preference for organic and sustainably sourced fibers, such as organic cotton or bamboo, in fabric production.

Promote Recycling Programs: encouraging collection and processing of reusable materials. Invest in recycling infrastructure, educate consumers, and collaborate with industry partners to reduce reliance on landfills and promote resource conservation.

Chemical Management: Adopt environmental friendly and less toxic chemicals in dyeing and finishing processes and implement closed-loop systems to recycle and reuse chemicals, minimizing overall usage.

Consumer Awareness: Educate consumers about the environmental impact of their choices, encouraging sustainable buying behaviors. Introduce programs that allow consumers to repair or recycle textile products.
Biodiversity: Organic Farming Practices: Promote organic farming methods that reduce reliance on pesticides and fertilizers, fostering healthier soil and water ecosystems.
Sustainable Forest Management: Adopt sustainable forest management practices to ensure responsible sourcing of fibers without contributing to deforestation.
Crop Rotation and Diversification: Implement crop rotation and diversification strategies to break monoculture patterns, preserving habitats and supporting biodiversity.

Water Recycling and Efficient Processes: Invest in water recycling technologies and adopt efficient manufacturing processes to minimize water usage and pollution in textile production, safeguarding aquatic biodiversity.
Customer Health and Safety: Chemical-Free Alternatives: Explore and adopt chemical-free alternatives in manufacturing processes to minimize the presence of harmful residues in finished textile products. Ensure the continuous improvement of safety standards.
Eco-Friendly Dyes: Prioritize the use of materials and dyes that are less likely to cause allergic reactions, considering the health and safety of consumers.

Safe Finishing Practices: Implement safe finishing practices, avoiding the use of hazardous agents, and opting for eco-friendly alternatives in treatments like wrinkle-resistant or water-repellent processes.

Transparent Labeling: Ensure transparent and accurate labeling on products, providing comprehensive information about care instructions, potential allergens, and any relevant safety concerns for consumers.
Promotion of Sustainable Consumption: Sustainable Choices Rewards: Provide incentives like loyalty points or discounts to encourage consumers who consistently make sustainable textile choices.
Affordability of Sustainable Products: Ensure that sustainable products are competitively priced to make them accessible to a wider consumer base.

Enhanced Supply Chain Visibility: Improve supply chain transparency by providing detailed information about the sourcing of raw materials and manufacturing processes, enabling consumers to make informed choices.
Sustainable Packaging Practices: Adopt sustainable packaging practices, including the use of eco-friendly materials and minimalistic designs, to reduce packaging waste in the textile industry.

policy.monitoring:
Exim Knits Private Ltd. remains steadfast in its dedication to transparency, accountability, and the ongoing enhancement of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles within its operational framework. To assess the current landscape and pinpoint opportunities for future improvement, we have instituted a thorough reporting mechanism. The pivotal components of our reporting approach are delineated below:

Environmental Performance Indicators:

Frequency: Annual/Monthly

Monitoring Areas: Energy consumption, water usage, waste generation, emissions, and more.

Monthly Records for Performance Evaluation:

Energy Audit Report

Water Consumption and Quality Report

GHG Emissions Report/Carbon Emissions Report

Waste Generation Record

Waste Treatment and Disposal Record

A consolidated document providing an overview of the company's overall performance in implementing environmental practices outlined in this policy.

An annual report summarizing all measures taken and improvements made in the company's sustainability practices, encompassing the broader spectrum of Environmental, Social, and Governance aspects.
policy.reviewMechanism:
To ensure the continuous relevance and effectiveness of this policy, an exhaustive review will be conducted annually. This evaluation will encompass updates in environmental legislation, technological advancements, and the evolving requirements of our stakeholders.

The ESG Team is tasked with a comprehensive evaluation of the policy's implementation, assessing the attainment of established targets, and proposing adjustments or enhancements to align with emerging environmental standards and best practices. Leveraging their collective expertise ensures a holistic perspective in addressing evolving challenges and opportunities.

Final approval for any policy adjustments lies with the CEO of Exim Knits Private Ltd, signifying the highest leadership endorsement for our environmental initiatives and emphasizing the organization's dedication to sustainability and responsible business practices. This systematic review process underscores our commitment to staying informed about changes in the environmental landscape and consistently improving our policies to meet the highest standards.

This policy is subject to an annual review, diligently tracking progress on each issue and its associated targets. The assessment will be conducted by representatives from pivotal departments within the organization, guaranteeing a comprehensive evaluation of our environmental initiatives. Any necessary adjustments or improvements will be recommended based on the outcomes of this annual review.
